task.maidmining.mining.desc: Searches for ores within a 3×3 chunk radius and digs tunnels to reach them. Put a raw ore in the offhand to target one ore type. Enchanted pickaxes work as expected: Fortune increases yield and Silk Touch keeps the block itself.
maidmining.msg.no_pickaxe: I need a pickaxe before I can mine!
maidmining.msg.no_ore_found: I could not find any ore nearby.
maidmining.msg.backpack_full: My backpack is full, so some ore was left on the ground.
